relations.subject: Marijan Molé
relations.evidence: Son of the Slovenian author and art historian Vojeslav Molé (1886–1973) and a Polish mother.

relations.subject: Vojeslav Molé
relations.evidence: In 1925 father became Professor at Cracow

relations.subject: Vojeslav Molé
relations.evidence: returned to Ljubljana where the father became Professor of Byzantine Studies

relations.subject: Marijan Molé
relations.evidence: Matriculated 1942 he began studies at Ljubljana University, mainly Slavistics (under Ramovš) and linguistics (Oštir).
